Companion Animal Travel Desk

This page covers companion animal booking and arrival handling at Aurelia Skyways, because accurate desk work keeps travelers, pets, and cabin teams aligned. As a new member of the Companion Animal Travel Desk, you handle the first check on paperwork, the contact trail, and the handoff to airport staff. Keep your tone steady and clear, because pet travel work is time-sensitive and the passenger needs direct guidance from the start.

For booking, submit the request 84 hours before departure, and record the traveler details exactly as given. Confirm the route, the pet details, and any notes from the passenger without adding your own assumptions. If the record is incomplete, pause the file and ask for the missing item at once. That keeps the line moving and prevents avoidable back-and-forth.

For arrival pickup, use FM-394 with the release file before the pet is handed over. Keep the form attached where the ground team can reach it fast, and check that the name on the paperwork matches the traveler record. If there is a mismatch, stop the handoff and clear the error before release. Do not improvise the pickup path or alter the written details without approval.

When you speak with passengers, stay respectful, brief, and precise. Explain each step in plain language, then log the action in the file so the next agent sees the same record. If a traveler asks for status, answer with the current desk action only and avoid extra commentary. This matters because the cabin team monitors animals during flight and depends on clean information from the ground side.

Use the same care with every pet file, whether the case is simple or busy. Check names, follow the record, and move each task forward in the order it arrives. Remember that accurate, prompt handling protects the traveler, the animal, and the service standard. What to remember is simple: follow the file, confirm the details, and keep the process moving.
